title: European Parliament to host joint assembly with African, Caribbean and Pacific states
excerpt: The second plenary session of the OACPS-EU Joint Parliamentary Assembly will take place from 9 to 13 November.
bodyHtml:
The European Parliament announced that approximately 160 parliamentarians from African, Caribbean and Pacific states will meet with members of the European Parliament from 9 to 13 November. The event marks the second plenary session of the Organisation of African, Caribbean and Pacific States – European Union (OACPS–EU) Joint Parliamentary Assembly under the Samoa Agreement.

Participants are scheduled to discuss security, multilateralism, ocean protection, financing for development, critical raw materials and the EU’s Global Gateway strategy. The assembly will include a youth forum, a women’s forum and a civil society consultation.

European Parliament President Roberta Metsola is scheduled to deliver an opening speech on 9 November, followed by an address from José Ramos-Horta, President of the Democratic Republic of Timor-Leste. A press briefing with co-presidents Francisco Assis and Thomas Tayebwa is scheduled for 14.00 on 9 November.
